name: Macquarie Regional and Remote Support Scholarship
summary: Yearly payment for full-time Macquarie undergraduates from regional or remote areas in financial hardship.
key: $10,000 per year, for up to 4 years.
who: Australian citizen, permanent resident or permanent humanitarian visa holder
From a regional or remote area and in financial hardship
Receiving Youth Allowance or another means-tested Commonwealth payment
how: Apply via the UAC Equity Scholarship Application Portal
catches: The page still shows 2024 round dates; check UAC for the current round

source.label: Macquarie University: Macquarie Regional and Remote Support Scholarship

evidence.quote: Be from a regional and remote area; Able to demonstrate financial hardship
